name: Drop all capabilities
description: Fail containers that do not drop all Linux capabilities or that add any back other than NET_BIND_SERVICE.
long_description: ISM-1246 (partial): Findings show selected Kubernetes workload hardening settings; they do not prove that all ASD and vendor guidance was identified, reconciled or implemented. ISM-1604 (partial): Findings show selected container isolation and workload hardening settings; they do not assess the Kubernetes control plane, node runtime configuration or every administrative interface used to manage the isolation mechanism. ISM-2128 (partial): Findings show whether workloads run privileged or add SYS_ADMIN, and whether regular or init containers add capabilities back after dropping ALL other than NET_BIND_SERVICE. The added-capability check does not cover ephemeral containers; these findings do not assess node access, driver signing or which privileged users can modify kernel-mode code.
remediation: Set securityContext.capabilities.drop=[ALL] and add back nothing except NET_BIND_SERVICE. Record any other documented need as a reviewed exception.

provenance.rationale: The local rule requires every regular and init container to drop ALL capabilities and allows only NET_BIND_SERVICE to be added back.
